Lessons.Title: Meters and Centimeters
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will make sense of the relative size of meters and centimeters and to express meters in terms of centimeters.
In earlier grades, you measured and estimated lengths in centimeters and meters to develop a sense of each. You learned that there are 100 centimeters in 1 meter. This lesson helps you see the relationship between centimeters and meters in terms of multiplicative comparison (MP7).
Core relationship: Meters and centimeters. Use 1 meter = 100 centimeters and keep both measures in one consistent unit.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Notice and Wonder: Big Bug, Little Bug	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  How Long is One Meter?	 (25 minutes); Activity 2:  In and Around the School	 (10 minutes); Cool-down:  The Longest Creatures	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: How many centimeters are in 3 meters?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): Convert 250 centimeters to meters and centimeters.
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
